skill.name: alan-plan
skill.description: Analyze a codebase, clarify requirements, draft an implementation plan, and save the plan as a versioned Alan artifact.
skill.summary: Create code-aware implementation plans and revisions in Alan.
skill.author: supatest-ai

security_audit.summary: All 29 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fenced examples, Mermaid labels, and ordinary prose. No shell execution, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection appears in SKILL.md. The remaining medium risk is intended external persistence of repository-derived plans and context identifiers to Alan.

remediation.issue: Plans and Alan context identifiers are sent to an external service before the user reviews the final artifact.
remediation.suggestion: Request confirmation before persistence and warn users to exclude secrets or sensitive repository details from plan content.

content.user_title: Create Actionable Implementation Plans in Alan
content.value_statement: Complex software changes need plans grounded in the existing codebase. This skill clarifies requirements, drafts visual plans, and stores versioned artifacts in Alan.
actual_capabilities: Explores repository architecture, dependencies, constraints, and risks without modifying source files.
Requests focused clarification when requirements remain ambiguous.
Creates free-form implementation plans with file paths, functions, dependencies, and reasoning.
Selects Mermaid sequence, schema, flowchart, state, C4, or data-flow diagrams when useful.
Creates Alan plan artifacts and links revisions through parent artifact identifiers.
limitations: Requires configured Alan MCP tools and valid task, conversation, and team context.
Creates plans but does not implement changes or modify source files.
Plan quality depends on accessible repository context and clear requirements.
Persisted plans may contain internal architecture details and require appropriate Alan access controls.

use_cases.title: Plan a new product feature
use_cases.description: Map affected modules, dependencies, risks, and validation work before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Review an architecture change
use_cases.description: Compare technical approaches and visualize service, schema, state, or data-flow changes.

use_cases.title: Revise a plan from feedback
use_cases.description: Recheck assumptions, address review comments, and create a linked plan revision in Alan.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation plan for [task]. Explore the repository without modifying files. Ask one question if a requirement is unclear.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a focused task with a clear outcome.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a cross-module feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan [feature] for this codebase. Identify affected files, dependencies, risks, and validation steps. Add a Mermaid diagram when relationships are complex.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when several modules or services may change.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an existing Alan plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Alan plan [artifact reference] against this feedback: [feedback]. Recheck relevant code, resolve ambiguities, and create a versioned revision.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after reviewers request corrections or scope changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a phased migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a phased migration from [current state] to [target state]. Compare alternatives, map system changes, sequence dependencies, and document rollback decisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex architecture or data migrations.

output_examples.input: Plan adding organization-level audit logs to the existing application.
output_examples.output: A phased plan covering event capture, storage schema, authorization, retention, query APIs, interface changes, tests, rollout, and a data-flow diagram.

output_examples.input: Revise the authentication migration plan after feedback about rollback safety.
output_examples.output: A linked revision that reassesses affected code, adds compatibility stages, defines rollback checkpoints, and addresses each feedback point.

best_practices: Provide the task goal, constraints, and relevant Alan artifact references.
Answer clarification questions before requesting the final plan.
Review plan content for secrets and sensitive architecture before external persistence.
anti_patterns: Do not request implementation or source-file changes from this planning skill.
Do not provide unrelated artifact identifiers or substitute one Alan context identifier for another.
Do not force diagrams for trivial changes with no meaningful relationships.

faq.question: Does this skill change source files?
faq.answer: No. It reads repository context and creates an implementation plan without modifying source files.

faq.question: Which Alan tools are required?
faq.answer: Plan creation requires the Alan create-plan MCP tool. Revisions may also use artifact retrieval and related artifact tools.

faq.question: How does the skill handle unclear requirements?
faq.answer: It asks one focused question at a time until the plan has enough confirmed context.

faq.question: Can it revise an existing plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It retrieves the previous artifact, addresses feedback, increments the title version, and links the revision to its parent.

faq.question: When does it add Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: It adds diagrams for complex relationships, service interactions, schemas, process flows, states, architecture, or data movement.

faq.question: What information is sent to Alan?
faq.answer: The plan content and task, conversation, and team identifiers are sent when the plan artifact is created.
